description: This is a Java utility class named 'CapitalizedIncomeAmortizationUtil' in the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to calculate total amortization amounts for capitalized income balances based on specific strategies, considering adjustment transactions, maturity date, and a cutoff date. It contains a primary public method for calculation based on different strategies and a private helper method for the 'EQUAL_AMORTIZATION' strategy.

classes.name: CapitalizedIncomeAmortizationUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to calculate total amortization of capitalized income balances based on different strategies.

methods.name: calculateTotalAmortizationTillDate
methods.description: Calculates the total amortization amount up to a specified date based on the given strategy.

methods.name: calculateTotalAmortizationTillDateEqualAmortization
methods.description: Private helper method for the 'EQUAL_AMORTIZATION' strategy; computes the amortization considering adjustment transactions, dates, and currency.
